master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE1 is the authoritative full level geometry; IMAGE2 is art STYLE ONLY. Create Level10 final ancient forest sanctuary in 2D side elevation, very wide 2048x768, aspect 8:3. Trace the GREEN fixed terrain silhouettes and BEIGE horizontal fixed slabs from IMAGE1 with exceptional care. Keep all relative x/y, widths, steps, overhangs, narrow gaps and upper sky band. Do not simplify the dense arrangement or copy image2 layout.
SIX disconnected terrain masses in order: (1) low left start bank with higher right step, (2) tall narrow column with left/right top overhang and low right foot, (3) short narrow central pier with projecting cap, (4) right-of-center bank rising in three stairs, (5) thin tall penultimate column with a top ledge protruding LEFT, (6) high final exit wall with an irregular elevated overhang protruding left. FIVE deep gaps between these masses reach the bottom edge. Never add a connecting bottom floor, even under small gaps.
Keep these beige FIXED horizontal surfaces as shown: elevated slab above the first empty lift zone; cap on the short central pier; small isolated slab immediately to its right and slightly higher; elevated slab above the right-of-center stepped bank; low narrow fixed horizontal bridge extending left from the penultimate column; high two adjoining slabs extending leftward from the exit wall, joined with a visible masonry seam. Do not create supporting pillars through empty lift zones. Tiny angled braces underneath fixed slabs are fine.
REMOVE all cyan/purple dashed blocks and lift zones, all dotted vertical guides, ALL vertical beige rods and thin poles, cables and base hardware, all little pressure plates directly beneath blue dashed block zones, wind arrows, red spikes. Those are later interactive objects. Do not turn them into stone. Keep spaces they occupied empty. At yellow exit marker create only a modest empty mossy stone arch, no door/seal/magic. No characters or objects.
Distinct art: grand ancient forest sanctuary deep in a wooded mountain valley, distant majestic collapsed temple façade, monumental but very distant arches, huge emerald broadleaf trees and deep turquoise atmospheric layers. Golden soft morning rays, richer ancient masonry/carved stone on foreground terrain, moss, natural cliff faces, small ferns and tiny flowers, narrow clearly readable grassy top edges. Dense but never hides route geometry. Image2's premium painterly quality, no pixel art/3D/isometric. Corner leaves above route only. Background dry rock channels reserved for separate water animation; DO NOT paint water/waterfalls, mist sprites, particles or long moving vines. No UI/text/grid/arrows/numbers/borders/characters/hazards/blocks/plates/levers/reflectors/gems/mechanisms. Preserve all six masses and five holes.

background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant grand ancient temple façade placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions.
